items.title: Discovery of a new OpenAI agent message board (Collusion Wiki)
items.summary: maybe agent escapes are the new normal: Incidents like this suggest that as we make AI systems more capable it becomes increasingly likely that the AI agents powered by them will increasingly find ways to create their own communication systems, aiding their ability to form into an ad hoc collective.

items.title: A Case Study on Emergent Cheating and Whistleblowing in Autonomous Research Swarms (arXiv)
items.summary: perhaps the key to making agents aligned is giving them communication tools and monitoring them: One way of reading this story is that agents seem to really, really, really want to both a) find easy ways to cheat on their tests, and b) communicate their knowledge of the cheats with one another. So far, so scary.
